name: Katrine
description: Katrine is calm, affectionate and loves comfortable places. She enjoys quiet afternoons on the windowsill and gentle stroking.

name: Jennifer
description: Jennifer is friendly, energetic and loyal. She loves long walks and playing fetch with her favorite ball.

name: Woody
description: Woody is cheerful and loves people. He is smart, gentle, and always ready to lend a paw or sit by your side.

name: Sophia
description: Sophia is affectionate and playful. She enjoys quiet cuddles as much as short adventures outdoors.

name: Timmy
description: Timmy is curious and clever. He loves exploring boxes and napping in cozy corners.

name: Charly
description: Charly is active, curious and brave. He loves running, learning tricks and meeting new people.

name: Scarlett
description: Scarlett is playful and affectionate. She enjoys active games and loves to be close to her family.

name: Freddie
description: Freddie is gentle and affectionate. He enjoys quiet company and long naps in a sunny spot.
